name: Baked Striped Bass (Or White Fish)
description: A whole striped bass or white fish baked with garlic, mushrooms, and herbs, served with a rich butter sauce.
recipeIngredient: 3 to 4 lb whole striped bass, dressed and boned

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F and lightly butter a large, shallow baking pan.
Wash and pat dry the fish with paper towels. Sprinkle inside and outside with salt and pepper.
Place the fish in the baking pan and add the remaining ingredients except for the sauce ingredients.
Bake, basting frequently with the liquid in the pan, for 40 minutes or until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
Carefully remove the fish to a heated serving platter, cover, and keep warm.
To make the sauce, cook the pan liquid over medium heat until it reduces to 1 cup, about 15 to 20 minutes.
Blend 1 teaspoon of butter with flour and stir into the hot liquid. Bring to a boil and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Reduce heat and add the remaining butter, shaking the pan until melted. Remove from heat.
Serve the sauce with the fish.

keywords: baked fish, striped bass, white fish, herb butter sauce

_similar.name: Crab-Stuffed Mushrooms
_similar.description: A savory appetizer featuring large mushrooms filled with a crab meat and cheese mixture, baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup grated Emmenthal or Gruyère cheese, divided

recipeInstructions.text: Wipe mushrooms with lemon juice. Remove stems for stuffing and set caps aside.
Trim and chop stems. In a saucepan, melt butter. Add onion and chopped mushroom stems. Cook until mushroom stems are tender and moisture has evaporated.
Stir in drained crab meat, 1/4 cup cheese, 1 tablespoon cracker crumbs, mayonnaise, salt, and pepper to taste. Mix well.
Spoon stuffing into mushroom caps and place on greased baking dish.
Combine remaining 1/4 cup cheese and 1 teaspoon cracker crumbs. Sprinkle evenly over stuffed mushrooms.
Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Bake in 400°F oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Serve hot.

_similar.name: Pork Chop & Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A casserole featuring pork chops, rice, and vegetables baked in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F and spray a 9x13 inch casserole pan with cooking spray.
Put raw rice in the casserole pan.
Melt butter or margarine and sauté green onions and garlic in a frying pan, then mix with rice.
Brown pork chops on both sides and place evenly on top of the rice mixture.
Place a slice of tomato, onion, and green pepper on top of each pork chop.
Pour beef broth over the casserole and cover with foil.
Bake in the oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until the liquid is absorbed.

_similar.name: Meat and Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole with ground beef, sliced potatoes, and corn, topped with a savory gravy.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef with onion and garlic. Season with salt and pepper.
Layer sliced potatoes in an 8L casserole dish.
Mix the gravy mix with 1 cup water and pour over the potatoes. Add remaining water.
Top with corn and the browned meat mixture.
Cover and cook at 350°F for 50 minutes.

_similar.keywords: meat casserole, potato and corn dish, gravy topping

_similar.name: Hearty Chicken Pot Pie
_similar.description: A comforting chicken pot pie filled with vegetables and chicken in a creamy sauce, topped with a pie crust.
recipeIngredient: 1 cup mixed vegetables (corn, carrots, leeks, mushrooms)
1 cup red wine or soya sauce

recipeInstructions.text: In a saucepan, simmer the mixed vegetables in chicken stock for 5 minutes.
In another saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Whisk in milk and red wine (or soya sauce). Bring to a boil and thicken.
Add cooked chicken, tarragon, lemon rind, salt, and pepper to the sauce. Mix well.
Pour the filling into unbaked pie shells.
Cover with top crust and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Serve hot. Note that the filling freezes well for later use.

_similar.keywords: chicken pot pie, comfort food, savory pie

_similar.description: A quick and flavorful red salmon spread perfect for crackers or sandwiches.

Mix well and serve with crackers or as a spread.
